stage.name: Frozen Abandoned City
stage.description:
Well-organized Reunion guerrillas are hiding in this abandoned nomadic city in the tundra of Ursus. Be prepared for the deathly chill, as that is your only hope for victory.
<Special Conditions> DP will not regenerate naturally.

yeti_operative.name: Yeti Operative
yeti_operative.flavourText: A basic melee combatants of the Yeti Squadron hailing from teams of infected guerilla warriors in the Northwestern Tundra. They are skilled at attacking frozen Operators.
abilities: Attack power increases when attacking Frozen targets

guerrilla_fighter.name: Guerrilla Fighter
guerrilla_fighter.flavourText: A basic guerilla fighter. After receiving tactical commands, they will gain increased capabilities and utilize a full range of offensive maneuvers.
abilities: When Inspired, gains Movement Speed.

infused_glacial_originium_slug_enemy_106.name: Infused Glacial Originium Slug
infused_glacial_originium_slug_enemy_106.flavourText: An infected wild creature native to colder environments that has become unstable due to assimilating a large amount of Originium into its abdomen. Upon death, they will explode and freeze nearby Operators. Due to their low intelligence, they are easily controlled by Yeti Squadron members for various tactical purposes.
abilities: Upon death, deals Physical damage in an area and applies Cold to affected targets

guerrilla_hound.name: Guerrilla Hound
guerrilla_hound.flavourText: A basic guerrilla-ops war hound equipped with lightweight Sarkaz armor, having decent defenses while still being able to move quickly.

frostfang.name: Frostfang
frostfang.flavourText: Creatures manipulated by the Yeti Squadron. Their bodies are equipped with a certain brand of monitoring equipment. Due to their speed and natural camouflage in the tundra environment, they can easily slip through our defenses and inflict massive damage. At the same time, they can inflict fatal damage to frozen Operators, and must be dealt with cautiously.
abilities: Attack power increases when attacking Frozen targets

infused_glacial_originium_slug_enemy_106.name: Infused Glacial Originium Slug α
infused_glacial_originium_slug_enemy_106.flavourText: An infected wild creature native to colder environments that has become unstable due to assimilating a large amount of Originium into its abdomen. More threatening than normal Infused Glacial Originium Slugs, they explode upon death, damaging and freezing nearby Operators. Due to their low intelligence, they are easily controlled by Yeti Squadron members for various tactical purposes.
abilities: Upon death, deals Physical damage in an area and applies Cold to affected targets

guerrilla_fighter_leader.name: Guerrilla Fighter Leader
guerrilla_fighter_leader.flavourText: A veteran guerilla fighter. After receiving tactical commands, they will gain increased capabilities and utilize a full range of offensive maneuvers.
abilities: When Inspired, gains Movement Speed.

yeti_sniper.name: Yeti Sniper
yeti_sniper.flavourText: A basic ranged combatants of the Yeti Squadron hailing from teams of infected guerilla warriors in the Northwestern Tundra. Their synergy with other Yeti Squadron members make them pose an immense threat to frozen Operators.
abilities: Attack power increases when attacking Frozen targets

guerrilla_herald_leader.name: Guerrilla Herald Leader
guerrilla_herald_leader.flavourText: Compared to regular heralds, these leaders have greater individual combat capabilities. The heralds are important links within their communication system. While present, they will issue tactical commands to increase the offensive and defensive abilities of nearby allies.
abilities: Increases the ATK and DEF of enemy units when on the battlefield.

guerrilla_herald.name: Guerrilla Herald
guerrilla_herald.flavourText: Patriot's guerilla fighters employ a special language to communicate and synergize their coordinated operations on the battlefield. The heralds are important links within their communication system. While present, they will issue tactical commands to increase the offensive and defensive abilities of nearby allies.
abilities: Increases the ATK and DEF of enemy units when on the battlefield.

yeti_caster.name: Yeti Caster
yeti_caster.flavourText: A basic caster of the Yeti Squadron hailing from teams of infected guerilla warriors in the Northwestern Tundra. Through special Arts and devices, they can inflict Cold on our Operators, reducing their attack speed and making them vulnerable to being Frozen.
abilities: After two attacks, the next attack applies the Cold effect

yeti_caster_leader.name: Yeti Caster Leader
yeti_caster_leader.flavourText: An elite caster of the Yeti Squadron hailing from teams of infected guerilla warriors in the Northwestern Tundra, boasting greater combat capabilities. Through special Arts and devices, they can inflict Cold on our Operators, reducing their attack speed and making them vulnerable to being Frozen.
abilities: After two attacks, the next attack applies the Cold effect

guerrilla_sniper_leader.name: Guerrilla Sniper Leader
guerrilla_sniper_leader.flavourText: A veteran guerilla sniper who has extensive professional, military-grade sharpshooting skills. After receiving tactical commands, they will gain increased capabilities and attack two targets at once.
abilities: When Inspired, attacks one additional target.

yeti_sniper_leader.name: Yeti Sniper Leader
yeti_sniper_leader.flavourText: Senior ranged combatants of the Yeti Squadron hailing from teams of infected guerilla warriors in the Northwestern Tundra. Their richer combat experience and synergy with other Yeti Squadron members make them pose an immense threat to frozen Operators.
abilities: Attack power increases when attacking Frozen targets

yeti_icecleaver.name: Yeti Icecleaver
yeti_icecleaver.flavourText: A special melee combatant of the Yeti Squadron hailing from teams of infected gerilla warriors in the Northwestern Tundra. Grim reapers on the battlefield, they wield long katanas that can easily ravage frozen Operators, hence the nickname they've been given, 'Ice Cleaver.'
abilities: Attack power increases greatly when attacking Frozen targets

oneiros.name: Oneiros
oneiros.flavourText: An unmanned, slow-flying enemy drone equipped with a special warhead released upon approaching Operators that inflicts Arts damage and a freezing effect in an area. Modified from the Bombtail, they lost their ability to accelerate after delivering the payload in order to accomodate a special warhead.
abilities: Flying unit.
Can launch a warhead to deal AoE Arts damage and apply the Cold effect to targets

guerrilla_shieldguard.name: Guerrilla Shieldguard
guerrilla_shieldguard.flavourText: One of Patriot's elite defenders. Carrying out Patriot's will, these shieldguards form the solid foundation of the 'Aegis of the Infected.' Equipped with high-performance protective armor, they cover for their comrades by drawing fire from enemies while present on the battlefield.
abilities: More likely to be targeted by attacks.

guerrilla_siegebreaker.name: Guerrilla Siegebreaker
guerrilla_siegebreaker.flavourText: One of Patriot's elite assault fighters. These troops specialize in assaults and airborne operations into enemy backlines. They wear medium armor and boast very strong individual combat capabilities. After receiving tactical commands, they will gain greatly increased combat capabilities and have greatly increased attack power.
abilities: Able to land directly onto the battlefield.
When Inspired, gains greatly increased ATK.

guerrilla_siegebreaker_leader.name: Guerrilla Siegebreaker Leader
guerrilla_siegebreaker_leader.flavourText: The cream of the crop among Patriot's elite assault fighters. Though boasting greater individual combat capabilities than normal Siegebreakers, they often end up behind bars. After receiving tactical commands, they will gain greatly increased combat capabilities and have greatly increased attack power.
abilities: Able to land directly onto the battlefield.
When Inspired, gains massively increased ATK.

yeti_icecleaver_leader.name: Yeti Icecleaver Leader
yeti_icecleaver_leader.flavourText: A special melee combatant of the Yeti Squadron hailing from teams of infected gerilla warriors in the Northwestern Tundra. Experienced executioners on the battlefield, they wield long katanas that can easily ravage frozen Operators, and their nickname, 'Ice Cleaver,' references their devastating blows that seem strong enough to split glaciers.
abilities: Attack power increases greatly when attacking Frozen targets

guerrilla_shieldguard_leader.name: Guerrilla Shieldguard Leader
guerrilla_shieldguard_leader.flavourText: The cream of the crop among Patriot's elite defenders. After extensive training, the Shieldguard Leaders don heavier protective armor and cover for their comrades by drawing fire from enemies while present on the battlefield.
abilities: More likely to be targeted by attacks.
